name: Stygeon
description: Stygeon was a snowy, mountainous planet that was home to a secret Separatist prison. Dark Lord of the Sith Sidious imprisoned his former apprentice Darth Maul after his excursion as a crime lord. Maul escaped with the help of his Mandalorian super commandos.
